hooks.command: bash -lc 'safe(){ printf "%s\n" "{\"continue\":true,\"stopReason\":\"SKINCOS supervisor: canonical Git root unavailable or invalid; automatic continuation is safely disabled\"}"; exit 0; }; common_raw="$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null)" || safe; [ -n "$common_raw" ] || safe; [ "$(basename -- "$common_raw")" = .git ] || safe; [ -d "$common_raw" ] && [ ! -L "$common_raw" ] || safe; common="$(CDPATH= cd -- "$common_raw" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P)" || safe; [ "$(basename -- "$common")" = .git ] || safe; root="$(dirname -- "$common")"; codex="$root/.codex"; hooks="$codex/hooks"; runner="$hooks/invoke-skincos-supervisor.sh"; [ -d "$codex" ] && [ ! -L "$codex" ] || safe; [ -d "$hooks" ] && [ ! -L "$hooks" ] || safe; [ -f "$runner" ] && [ ! -L "$runner" ] || safe; hooks_real="$(CDPATH= cd -- "$hooks" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P)" || safe; [ "$hooks_real" = "$hooks" ] || safe; exec "$runner"'
hooks.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $safe='{\"continue\":true,\"stopReason\":\"SKINCOS supervisor: canonical Git root unavailable or invalid; automatic continuation is safely disabled\"}'; try { $commonRaw=(& git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>$null); if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($commonRaw)) { throw 'git-common-dir unavailable' }; $common=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath($commonRaw.Trim()); if ((Split-Path -Leaf $common) -cne '.git') { throw 'invalid git common directory' }; $root=Split-Path -Parent $common; $codex=Join-Path $root '.codex'; $hooks=Join-Path $codex 'hooks'; $runner=Join-Path $hooks 'invoke-skincos-supervisor.ps1'; foreach ($entry in @($root,$common,$codex,$hooks,$runner)) { $item=Get-Item -LiteralPath $entry -Force -ErrorAction Stop; if (($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) -ne 0) { throw 'reparse point refused' } }; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $root -PathType Container) -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $common -PathType Container) -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $codex -PathType Container) -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $hooks -PathType Container) -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $runner -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'canonical runner unavailable' }; & $runner } catch { [Console]::Out.WriteLine($safe) }"
